description: Unit test class for TenantTraceSamplingHandler, verifying span tagging based on tenant config, auth headers, and client certificates within the org.eclipse.hono.service.http package.
external_methods: mocked request headers and sslSession methods

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for TenantTraceSamplingHandler, testing span tagging based on tenant configurations, headers, and client certificates.

classes.name: EmptyCertificate
classes.description: A minimal stub implementation of X509Certificate for testing SSL client certificate handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test setup before each test.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingTenant
methods.description: Verifies that the span priority is set to 'all' when tenant specifies 'trace-sampling-mode' as 'all'.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingAuthId
methods.description: Verifies span priority for tenants where 'trace-sampling-mode-per-device' is 'all' for a specific authId.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingAuthIdInSingleTenantMode
methods.description: Verifies span priority in single tenant configuration for a matching authId.

methods.name: testHandleRespectsOverrideForAuthId
methods.description: Ensures that 'default' sampling mode overrides specific device configuration.

methods.name: setupBasicAuthHttpServerRequest
methods.description: Helper to set up mock HttpServerRequest with basic auth headers.

methods.name: setupNonSslHttpRequest
methods.description: Helper to set up mock HttpServerRequest as non-SSL.

methods.name: setupClientCertHttpRequest
methods.description: Helper to set up mock HttpServerRequest with client SSL certificate.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenTenantParam
methods.description: Verifies span priority for requests parameterized by tenant param, using tenant config.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenDeviceParam
methods.description: Verifies span priority for device param with tenant config.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenCert
methods.description: Verifies span priority for a request authenticated with a client certificate associated with tenant 'all' mode.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenCertUsingSubjectDn
methods.description: Verifies span priority for a client cert with subject DN mapped to tenant 'all' mode.
